reports.headline: The Bride Has Come Back
reports.body: The old chapel {dir} of the village {dist} has been seen lit at night, though no one has a key. {name} looked through the window and saw a figure in a veil standing at the altar, waiting, and other things crawling between the pews. One of the watchmen has not been seen since.

reports.headline: Do Not Go to the Chapel
reports.body: {name} heard a wedding hymn from the chapel {dir} of here {dist}, sung by a voice that was not a voice. Whatever stands at the altar is the heart of it: the rest, folk say, only serve her.
